decision: Separated mixed-enum reflection from direct enum throw transport
why: Typed catches now recover the native variant correctly, while reflection still confuses Haxe constructor order with OCaml runtime tags
result: direct throw work closed; reflection bug remains open

decision: Require generated enum metadata instead of a runtime tag-offset guess
why: Constant and payload constructors can be interleaved, so one numeric offset would return believable but incorrect names and indices
result: investigating the smallest typed metadata boundary

decision: Froze mixed-shape enum reflection across Haxe interpreter, JavaScript, and Neko
why: The target fix needs an upstream behavior oracle for names, declaration indices, parameters, constructor order, and runtime factories
result: 13 cases pass on all 3 upstream Haxe 4.3.7 routes

decision: Kept Dynamic array-element boxing out of the reflection-runtime patch
why: The first native run showed that array literals bypass the existing planned enum-to-Dynamic local conversion; teaching reflection to guess the missing enum name would hide that separate carrier bug
result: array-element conversion has its own open typed-lowering Bead

decision: Generated one constructor layout containing Haxe index and exact OCaml representation tag
why: Reflection, declaration-order listing, and indexed factory creation need one authoritative mapping instead of independent raw-tag interpretations
result: focused native fixture passes names, indices, parameters, and factories

decision: Regenerated all ten OCaml snapshot families through the compiler
why: The checked-in examples must show the same explicit Haxe-index-to-OCaml-tag mapping that the target now emits; generated output was rebuilt rather than hand-edited
result: full snapshot and OCaml parse gate passes

decision: Kept nine broad portable failures out of the enum reflection implementation
why: The new enum fixture passes; the red fixtures expose stale direct-throw evidence checks, target-neutral fingerprint null access, and a missing anonymous-object plan that occur outside this mapping
result: 88 of 97 portable fixtures pass; three bounded follow-up owners opened
